name: Wolf Bolo Two
source:
Three planets became partly submerged in the Obsidian Sea during The Downheaval, rendering most populations trapped in Stasis. Then Bolo Drives, containing Wolves for Wielders to wield, appeared everywhere. The three planets search to find a legendary Bolo Drive, with the ability to turn worlds: The Æmicus. Will Pteri find The Æmicus before it’s too late for her?

[From [url=https://wagleunagi.itch.io/wolf-bolo-two]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在巨变期间，三颗行星部分淹没在黑曜石海中，使大多数人口陷入停滞状态。然后，包含供使用者挥舞的狼的波洛驱动器随处可见。三颗行星寻找具有扭转世界能力的传奇波洛驱动器：埃米库斯。Pteri能在为时已晚之前找到The Æmicus吗？

[来自[url=https://wagleunagi.itch.io/wolf-bolo-two]Itch.io[/url]]
